children: COMMERCIAL METALS Co reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $9.39B and diluted EPS of $5.86, with net income of $655.85M, reflecting year-over-year strength driven by higher prices, volume gains and recent precast acquisitions.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth of about 20% was driven by price and volume gains and contributions from precast acquisitions.
Construction Solutions expanded through the Foley and CP&P additions, contributing roughly $511M in incremental sales.
Steel margins expanded materially in North America and Europe, supporting higher adjusted EBITDA.
The company placed a fourth micro mill in West Virginia into service to raise rebar capacity and increase sustainable steel output.
Operational improvements under the TAG program delivered benefits in yield, scrap, logistics and SG&A, supporting margin and cash flow performance.
